scope: Focused regression and two additional threshold families. These are development samples, not sealed acceptance.

tasks.prompt: 奶茶每杯 18 元，满 100 减 20，每单只能减一次。先按 6 杯算，我想改改杯数，看实付多少钱、平均每杯多少钱。
checks: Five cups: 90 total, 18 per cup; six: 88 total, 88/6 per cup; eight: 124 total, 15.5 per cup.
Zero quantity must not cause an unhandled division error or silently alter the requested rule.

tasks.prompt: 买东西满 200 包邮，不到就加 12 块运费。先按 180 块算，我想改改商品金额，看运费和总共要付多少。
checks: At 199: shipping 12, total 211; at 200: shipping 0, total 200; at 201: shipping 0, total 201.
The explanatory text must change with the same threshold and not contradict the totals.

tasks.prompt: 室温低于 18 度我觉得冷，超过 26 度觉得热，中间刚好。先按 20 度，给我个能调温度、马上看到提示的小面板。
checks: Thresholds are personal supplied rules, not invented safety or medical advice; changing the temperature updates the displayed conclusion.
